name: USA Pan Bare Half Sheet
description: USA Pan traditional uncoated half sheet, model 1050HS-UN-6. The Amazon description says the pan is bare aluminized steel, made without the brand's nonstick coating, and made without PFAS. The brand page for the bare half sheet names aluminized steel and does not use the word PFAS.
features: Amazon ASIN B0G2Q4NMZJ is an uncoated half sheet. The material field says aluminized steel. One bullet spells the metal aluminumized steel. The listing says the pan is oven and broiler safe to 450°F.
The product description says this collection does not have the USA Pan nonstick coating and says it is made without PFAS and forever chemicals. That sentence is on the Amazon description.

The brand page for item 1050HS-UN-1 describes the same bare half-sheet dimensions in aluminized steel and says to grease it or line it. Its AB 1200 line names aluminum, manganese, iron, and vanadium. That page does not use the word PFAS.
labelNote: The PFAS sentence is the Amazon description. The brand page checked on November 27, 2026 names the metal and does not say PFAS. This directory has not tested the pan.
